BiblicalUsage: Zephath is a city in the south of Judah that Israel destroyed and renamed Hormah. In Judges 1:17, they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zephath reminds me Scripture happened somewhere, not in the abstract.
